mapper.insert: INSERT INTO source_mapping (data_source_id, mapping_version, source_schema_json, mapping_json, feature_contract_version, feature_contract_sha256, status, requested_by) VALUES (#{sourceId}, #{mappingVersion}, #{sourceSchemaJson}, #{mappingJson}, #{contractVersion}, #{contractSha256}, 'draft', #{requestedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM source_mapping WHERE data_source_id=#{sourceId} AND mapping_version=#{mappingVersion} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
